dict.string: Zeh L'Zeh Rescue uses your location to show food-rescue pickups near you and to let the office see where drivers are while they're on an active pickup. Location sharing is opt-in and only active while the app is open.

Zeh L'Zeh Rescue uses your location to show food-rescue pickups near you and to let the office see where drivers are while they're on an active pickup. Location sharing is opt-in and only active while the app is open.

Zeh L'Zeh Rescue uses the camera so drivers can attach a proof photo when they pick up or deliver food, and so suppliers can take a photo of the food they're posting for pickup. Camera access is only requested when you tap Take Photo.
Zeh L'Zeh Rescue lets you choose an existing photo from your library to attach to a pickup or supplier post instead of taking a new one. Photos are only accessed when you tap Add a Photo.
Zeh L'Zeh Rescue saves receipts and shipping labels to your photo library when you tap Save.
